message: Remember, each tome will continue to help you even when you leave this realm.
Here, you can see the full view of the land outside of Xal's study.
Keep channeling essence to cleanse corrupted creatures and gather influence from the realm.
Don't forget to return to Xal every few levels to progress further in the story.
Your magic has begun to grow in strength. Keep casting to get even more potent.
Return to the realm everyday to earn extra influence.
Your experience in Tomes has dramatically increased. Keep purchasing Tomes to increase their effectiveness.
Arcane Surge unlocked: Reach a 10-spell combo to unleash chain lightning across every creature in the valley.
Ancient Vessels unlocked: Reach a 25-spell combo to draw out a radiant golden vessel—catch it 3 times before it escapes.
Total Extraction unlocked: Your 10th-spell Arcane Surge now strikes twice and cleanses corrupted creatures in a single burst.
